resources.string: Start what matters, when you said you would.
At the time you choose, COMMAND rings, tells you your first step, and asks you to confirm that you are starting.
You stay in charge. Every permission is optional and explained, and you can change your mind at any time.
Everything stays on this phone unless you turn on an optional feature that says otherwise.
COMMAND works best with these. Skipping any of them is fine; the app will tell you what that costs.
You can review all of this again under Reliability.
A mission is one thing you want to start at a set time. You can try its alarm before you save it.
Your missions are still here. You can add more at any time.
